mechanism_narrative: EGFR (RTK) and IL6ST/gp130 (cytokine receptor, JAK-associated) forced proximity via flexible_GS4 linker (~20 Å) is predicted to enable bidirectional trans-signaling: EGFR's TK domain may phosphorylate IL6ST ICD tyrosines creating STAT3 docking sites, while JAK1/JAK2 bound to IL6ST may transphosphorylate EGFR C-tail tyrosines enhancing GRB2/SHC1/GAB1/PIK3R1 recruitment. This hybrid signaling is predicted to activate MAPK-ERK, PI3K-AKT, and JAK-STAT3 pathways simultaneously. PLCG1 is predicted as sterically excluded because its productive docking requires specific EGFR pY1173 geometry that may be incompatible with the co-clustered IL6ST ICD. The biased output is predicted to drive a myogenic/youthful transcriptome (ACTA2, MYL9, MYH11, MYOG up) while suppressing aged inflammatory IEGs (EGR1, FOS, JUN, IL32 down) — analogous to H2F but with added STAT3-mediated SOCS3 feedback. Note: this is a heterologous RTK+cytokine pair with no published precedent; the mechanism is inferred from known individual receptor biochemistry.
